name: Contact 9
definition: Specifies the details of the contact person.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the party, such as a person or a team, responsible for the report.

PhoneNumber.name: Phone Number
PhoneNumber.definition: Phone number of the person responsible for the report.

EmailAddress.name: Email Address
EmailAddress.definition: Electronic mail (e-mail) address of the of the person responsible for the report.

Function.name: Function
Function.definition: Function of the person responsible for the report.
